evidence_items.publisher: Cognition / Elsevier; author abstract indexed by PubMed
evidence_items.explanation: The reported experiment demonstrates a vigilance decrement during sustained monitoring. The same abstract reports that intermittent task switches prevented the decrement, limiting any claim that decline is unavoidable under every task design.

unresolved_gaps: The experiment does not prove a universal mathematical limit on attention in every individual and task.
The underlying data-collection dates are not specified in the cited abstract; the event year identifies the reported experimental finding.
